name: Pressure Point
detailed_description:
What is "Pressure Point"?

Pressure Point is a high-stakes mystery visual novel doubling as a psychological thriller. Inspired by the World War 2 era, this game takes place in a militaristic environment. Major global powers are currently taking part in a widescale war, with nothing but chaos reigning amidst the expansive continent of Elyndra.

Join an eccentric cast of characters aboard the Experimental Vessel X-53 “Observer-9”, a highly equipped diesel-electric submarine. What starts as a confidential naval strategy mission turns into a game of wits, survival, and mental resilience.

In Pressure Point, every choice matters. Interrogate crewmates, search for clues, expose any traitors, and uncover the ultimate truth of the world. 

Story

Meet Lina Volkner. Lina has been selected for a top secret naval strategy mission: Operation Echo Veil. 

This is an opportunity of a lifetime in her country! In Zylferia, The Land of Opportunity, joining the military is a goal to be strived for by all citizens.

Zylferia is a country with heavily closed borders. It stands as a beacon of light during the wartime, as its citizens are protected from the gruesome conditions of the outside world. The Zylferians spearhead The Unified Front, four nations that stand against The Central Pact’s invasion.

Soon enough, Lina finds herself submerged 1,000 feet beneath the ocean, stuck in close quarters with 17 mysterious individuals. Captain Mariya Ivanova steps up as a mentor figure for Lina, taking her under her wing, 

But when the Captain reveals that there is a traitor on board…it soon turns out that not everyone is what they seem. 

Paranoia begins spreading within the walls of the submarine. Sabotage, chaos, treachery…underneath the ocean’s surface, there is no escape. With one wrong move, Lina may find herself the next to disappear.

Who onboard is a traitor? What is the true nature of Operation Echo Veil, and why was each person recruited for this mission? 

Expose the traitor and uncover the truth.

Features:

  • Multiple unique endings based on your choices

  • Lengthy debate sequences where you discuss clues and vote out the traitor

  • Various mini-games based on interrogation, investigation, logical deduction, and submarine warfare

  • Social mechanics where you bond with your crewmates and explore the submarine together

  • Psychological complexities and moral dilemmas. What kind of person will Lina become?

Pressure Point is not about good or evil. It‘s about survival.

Will you work alongside your allies for a common goal? Or will you choose to prioritize yourself in a high-tension, enclosed environment? The choice is yours alone.

Trust or Distrust. Which will you choose?

==AI ART DISCLOSURE==
All of the AI art shown is entirely placeholder and will be replaced as the game approaches release.

short_description: Board the Observer-9 submarine, your new personal hell, for a deadly battle of wits and survival! Investigate your surroundings and interrogate your crewmates to uncover traitors that pose a threat to your nation. Engage in high-tension debates to expose the traitor…and vote them to be executed!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 7
  • Processor: 2.8 GHz Intel Core 2 or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2 or DirectX 9.0 compatible GPU with a minimum of 1GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Pressure Point contains psychological horror themes. It is not suitable for children or those who are easily disturbed. This game includes death, blood, violence, and deals with heavy subject matters.
